# #3260: Patch: a phone highlights nothing but the chat
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

### What it does

On a phone, the web client should not highlight anything except in the chat:

- no text selection (a long press on a card, a button or the board selects nothing),
- no long-press callout (`-webkit-touch-callout`),
- no grey tap flash (`-webkit-tap-highlight-color`).

The chat panel (`apps/web/src/together/ChatPanel.tsx`, `.chat-panel` in `together/together.css`) keeps all three, so a message can still be pressed, selected and copied. Text fields everywhere (`input`, `textarea`, `contenteditable`) keep selection, since iOS will not type into or put a caret in a field that cannot be selected. Selection and the callout are off only under `(pointer: coarse)`, so a narrow desktop window still selects text; the tap flash is off at every pointer, because only touch browsers draw one.

**A draft is already on the branch `claude/mobile-no-highlight`** (commit on top of `9d8aaea`). Start from it or rebuild it as you see fit:

- `apps/web/src/index.css`: `html { -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent }`, plus a `(pointer: coarse)` block that sets `user-select: none` / `-webkit-touch-callout: none` on `html` and gives fields their text back.
- `apps/web/src/together/together.css`: `.chat-panel` restores the tap highlight (`initial`), the callout (`default`) and `user-select: text`.
- `apps/web/src/game/board.css`: removes the #2015 zone rule. Its `-webkit-tap-highlight-color: initial` on a zone's children would bring the flash back on cards, and the page-wide rule covers the rest.
- `apps/web/src/game/Zone.test.tsx`: the #2015 CSS test now checks the new rules.

The draft's web tests have **not** been run yet (the session's WebAssembly build had not finished), so treat them as unverified.

### Acceptance

- `pnpm --dir apps/web test` passes, the stylesheet lint tests included (`palette`, `typescale`, `surfaces`, `motion`, `cursors`, `typography`).
- A unit test holds: `html` takes no tap highlight; under `(pointer: coarse)` `html` takes `user-select: none` and `-webkit-touch-callout: none`; inputs, textareas and `contenteditable` take `user-select: text`; `.chat-panel` restores all three; and nothing in `board.css` sets the tap highlight back to `initial`.
- At 390x844 with touch emulation (e2e or the ui-walkthrough), a long press on a hand card selects no text and opens no callout, while chat message text can be selected.
- Typing in the chat compose field and the sign-in fields still works on a touch device.

### Blocked by, part of

None. Follows up #2015.
